# NapaProTransfer

> Private Taxi & 24/7 Airport Transfer Service in Ayia Napa and Protaras, Cyprus.

NapaProTransfer provides reliable, pre-booked private taxi transfers, airport pickups/drop-offs, and long-distance intercity journeys across Cyprus, specializing in the Famagusta District (Ayia Napa and Protaras).

## Core Services & Starting Rates
- **Standard Private Taxi Transfer**: €63–€75
- **Big Taxi Transfer**: €80–€100
- **Mercedes V-Class Transfer (Groups/Families)**: €90–€130

## Primary Routes & Coverage
- Larnaca International Airport (LCA) <-> Ayia Napa
- Larnaca International Airport (LCA) <-> Protaras
- Paphos International Airport (PFO) <-> Ayia Napa / Protaras
- Intercity & long-distance private transfers across Cyprus

## Operating Hours & Payment
- **Pre-booked Transfers**: Available 24/7 (including night flights and early morning pickups)
- **Direct Phone Booking Line**: 09:00 – 11:30 (EET)
- **WhatsApp & Email Inquiries**: Available 24/7
- **Accepted Payments**: Cash and Credit/Debit Cards

## Contact & Booking Details
- **Website**: https://napaprotransfer.com
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +357 99963259

- **Base Location**: Ayia Napa & Protaras, Famagusta District, Cyprus
